The mission

Phones are an ops risk

The Navy banned smartphones on bases and ships in 2019. The Army ordered 89 apps deleted in 2020. Recovery can't add risk.

The post

Zero bars, full session

High-altitude and border posts have patchy or no connectivity. It all runs on the device.

The household

For every Indian home 🇮🇳

Crores of Indians still use feature phones. RHYTUAL works on its own, for anyone.

The rulebook

Compliant by default

Offline, no camera, no data out. Designed to clear unit security protocols, not fight them.

Sources: Indian Navy directive, December 2019; Indian Army directive, July 2020.

The science

Decades of research. Now in your hands.

Tap or hover a card to see what's behind it.

Why "Tappers"

Every pulse is a gentle tap in your palm.

A precision haptic motor in each tapper delivers a soft, alternating vibration, left then right. Add a left-right tone and a guiding glow, and the rhythm reaches you three ways at once.

Touch

Haptic pulses

A soft vibration under each thumb. Speed, intensity, pulse length and pause, all adjustable.

Sound

Left-right tone

An optional tone that travels ear to ear through headphones, in step with the taps.

Light

A guiding glow

A warm light that crosses from one tapper to the other, readable with eyes half closed.

A daily recovery ritual you can hold, that works offline and supports the care you already have.EMDR therapy or a medical device. It doesn't diagnose, treat or cure any condition.

The team behind the innovation

A leap of faith, built on a struggle.

  1. The retreat

    Two ten-day Vipassana retreats. Twenty days of silence, and a calm he had never felt before.

  2. The struggle

    Back home, the practice faded within weeks. The hard part was never the retreat. It was keeping the ritual alive.

  3. The builder

    Years scaling brand at India's biggest manufacturing startup, then at one of India's most advanced neo-prime defence companies 🇮🇳. He learnt how to build here, and who it matters most to.

  4. The leap · August 2026

    Full-time on RHYTUAL. To build the ritual he couldn't keep, for the people who need it most.

FAQ

Good questions.

What is RHYTUAL?

RHYTUAL is an Indian recovery brand built with our defence forces. Its first product, RHYTUAL Tappers, is a pair of palm-sized, pebble-like devices that pulse left and right in time with your breath, to help you recover and relax after a hard day. The name joins rhythm and ritual: showing up consistently, with meaning.

What does a session feel like?

Hold one tapper in each palm and close your eyes. The tappers lead, your breath follows: inhale as the left pulses, exhale as the right. Then make it yours. Choose your breathing pattern (box, long-exhale, pranayama-style or your own), your focus pattern (alternate, double or breath-synced), and set speed, intensity, pulse and pause. That personal rhythm is the magic behind deep recovery: a ten-minute Reset after duty, a twenty-minute Deep Rest before sleep.

Do I need a smartphone?

No. Every session runs on the tappers, fully offline. A small remote with a screen and real buttons does everything an app would. No phone, no signal, no screen.

Is it therapy or a medical device?

No. RHYTUAL is a recovery aid inspired by the bilateral rhythm used in EMDR therapy. It doesn't diagnose, treat or cure anything, and it works alongside the care you already have.

Who is it for?

Built first for India's 🇮🇳 Army, Navy, Air Force, CAPFs, Assam Rifles and their families. Then for anyone who needs to come down: night-shift workers, first responders, caregivers, everyone.

Is it really made in India? 🇮🇳

Yes. Engineered and built in India 🇮🇳 with Indian electronics partners, and designed to the same defence standards our forces use.

When can I get one?

Soon. The first production run is a limited batch: an exclusive release for India's defence forces 🇮🇳, and a restricted release for civilians. The waitlist gets first access, the full specs and pricing before anyone else.

What does the ऋ on each tapper mean?

ऋ (ṛ) is the Sanskrit root of ṛta, the natural order and rhythm of life. It's debossed on every tapper, like a quiet signature.

How much will it cost?

Three ways in: RHYTUAL Tappers + Remote (fully offline), an optional annual mobile app subscription, and community experiences. Pricing is shared on request, and waitlist members hear it first.

Is it safe for everyone?

It's gentle by design. If you have a medical or mental-health condition, are pregnant, or use an implanted device such as a pacemaker, check with a doctor first.
